title: VA Home Loan Guaranty Partial Claim Balance Still Owed, with Interest by Whole Year
content:
When a new VA partial claim is figured on a VA Home Loan Guaranty loan, the partial claim debt carried against the ceiling depends on how long ago the latest partial claim on the loan was paid and on whether partial claim repayments were received, as the partial claim entries and partial claim repayment entries in the loan's money transactions show.

## Partial claim debt carried against the ceiling

1. Where the latest partial claim on the loan was paid at least twelve months before today, the partial claim debt carried against the ceiling is the partial claims paid less the repayments received, plus simple interest on that remainder at the partial claim interest rate for each whole year since the latest was paid.
2. Where the latest was paid less than twelve months before today and partial claim repayments were received, it is the partial claims paid less the repayments received.
3. Otherwise it is the partial claims paid.

The partial claim interest rate is the program's rate, 1.0 percent a year on every program. The whole years are the whole months since the latest partial claim was paid, divided by 12 with any remainder dropped. Under the first rule the amount is the remainder multiplied by one plus the rate divided by one hundred times the whole years, rounded to the cent.

## Cases (hypothetical loans)

| Partial claims paid | Repayments received | Latest paid (months before today) | Debt carried against the ceiling |
|---|---|---|---|
| 20,000.00 | 2,000.00 | 30 (2 whole years) | 18,000.00 multiplied by 1.02, or 18,360.00 |
| 20,000.00 | 0.00 | 12 (1 whole year) | 20,000.00 multiplied by 1.01, or 20,200.00 |
| 20,000.00 | 2,000.00 | 11 | 18,000.00 |
| 20,000.00 | 0.00 | 11 | 20,000.00 |
| None | None | — | 0.00 |

A loan whose latest partial claim was paid 23 months before today has 1 whole year; at 24 months it has 2.
